name: jengo/auth
description: Unified Authentication and Authorization Engine for the Jengo framework. Provides multi-identity auth, universal guards (Bearer Token + Session Cookie auto-detection), Vima hierarchical RBAC, explicit deny precedence, model ABAC policies, audit logging, declarative PHP 8 attributes, standardized FormHandlers, and auto-generated REST endpoints.

attributes.description: Forces authentication on the target controller or method. Defaults to Universal Guard, with optional specific guard parameter (session or token).
Verifies that the authenticated user possesses the specified permission or passes the policy check for the target resource.

arguments.permission: string (The permission slug or policy action name)
arguments.resource: string (Optional route parameter name to bind to policy)
arguments.schema: class-string (Optional Schema class for model resolution)

attributes.usage:
#[Can('update', resource: 'id', schema: PostSchema::class)]
public function update(int $id) {}

attributes.description: Restricts access to users having one or more specified roles.
Restricts access to unauthenticated guest users (redirects logged-in users to home/dashboard).

helpers.name: auth
helpers.description: Entry point for all authentication, token management, authorization checks, and RBAC user mutations.

helpers.name: vima
helpers.description: Direct access to the underlying Vima authorization manager.

facades.description: Static facade accessing the Jengo AuthManager.

methods.check: check(): bool (Returns true if a valid user is authenticated)
methods.id: id(): int|string|null (Returns the authenticated user ID)
methods.login: login(User $user, bool $remember = false): void (Manually logs in a user)
methods.logout: logout(): void (Logs out user and invalidates session/token)
methods.attempt: attempt(array $credentials, bool $remember = false): bool (Attempts credential authentication)
methods.can: can(string $permission, mixed $resource = null): bool (Evaluates permission/policy with explicit deny precedence)
methods.cannot: cannot(string $permission, mixed $resource = null): bool (Inverse of can())
methods.authorize: authorize(string $permission, mixed $resource = null): void (Throws AccessDeniedException if forbidden)
methods.user_resource: user(int|string|User $user): UserResource (Returns fluent resource manager for grants/denies)

guards.description: Intelligently authenticates incoming requests by detecting Bearer token headers first and falling back to session cookies.
Validates SHA-256 hashed Personal Access Tokens with custom abilities and expiration.
Stateful session guard managing user sessions, CSRF validation, and Remember-Me cookies.

commands.name: jengo:auth setup
commands.description: Run the Jengo Auth setup wizard and publish configurations.

commands.name: jengo:auth import:shield
commands.description: Migrates users, identities, permissions, and tokens from CodeIgniter Shield to Jengo Auth.

commands.name: jengo:auth grant
commands.description: Grant a role or direct permission to a user.

commands.name: jengo:auth deny
commands.description: Explicitly deny a permission for a user (overrides all grants).

commands.name: jengo:auth sync
commands.description: Synchronize policy mappings and static permissions into the database.

commands.name: jengo:make policy <name>
commands.description: Generate a new authorization Policy class.

commands.name: jengo:make role <name>
commands.description: Generate a new Role with optional parent inheritance.
